reading.body:
Puerto Rico has one tracked data center facility, a Microsoft site in Guaynabo, with zero megawatts of recorded capacity.

The single entry raises more questions than it answers. A facility can be mapped and attributed to an operator without its power draw being known, and that gap is precisely what matters for AI infrastructure analysis. Compute scales with power, and a capacity figure of zero means this record marks a presence but cannot support any conclusion about the site's role in AI workloads.

The data does not cover what the facility does, how large it is, when it was commissioned, or whether the zero-megawatt figure reflects missing data or an inactive site. Puerto Rico's grid history and its separation from continental interconnects would be relevant context for any serious assessment, but nothing in this record speaks to either. What it establishes is only that one Microsoft facility in Guaynabo exists in this taxonomy.
